description: This source file defines the code-behind for the SignUpPage of an online examination system. It handles page load, redirecting to login, and processing user sign-up by saving user info and uploaded images to a database.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: A partial class representing the sign-up page, handling user registration and page events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently no logic implemented.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the login page when the login button is clicked.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Processes the user registration, including saving user info and uploaded image to the database, and performs password validation.
